summary: Penpot is a web-based platform designed for interface design and interactive prototyping. It enables multidisciplinary teams to collaborate on visual layouts within a browser environment. As an open-source alternative to proprietary design tools, it provides a dedicated workspace for creating digital products.
goodFor: Teams looking for a self-hosted design and prototyping tool that avoids proprietary cloud ecosystems and subscription lock-in.
watchOut: Migrating existing assets from established proprietary design tools can sometimes introduce formatting inconsistencies or require manual layout adjustments.
deployNotes: Because the application runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
